set.body: From S3.7 slice 7 (trialPreview). eyes4s has no public way to estimate one trial under a prepared plan at a caller-chosen estimate; StudyPlan.estimateTrial is private[plan]. Add PreparedStudy.estimate(key, estimate): Either[StudyFailure[K], DensityView[U]], the same whole-trial operation the runner performs: frame and window checks, path policy (initial fixation, off-window), the weighted measure, then StudyDensity. Law: it equals the runner's per-trial estimate for every trial and estimate. Typed failures name the key. Run the API audit. Then the real backend's trialPreview and the fake (which currently re-assembles this pipeline from Smoother, i.e. science in studio code) both call it, and MapGridOf previews can use it.
set.title: eyes4s-plan: public single-trial estimate (PreparedStudy.estimate)
